value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical ten-vertex distance-regular control benchmark; classifying all independently actuated vertex sets and proving that 104 optimal placements persist across every positive nonunit defect gives a directly reusable exact benchmark, surpassing the general known eigenvalue-multiplicity bound and one constructed optimizer. The all-parameter result is not a numerical toy, routine substitution, or arbitrary unmotivated subset.
